words.clue: The request you give an AI. Also what an actor needs when the next line has departed.
Your question or an uploaded photo goes into the AI system as this.
The answer or image an AI system returns, whether brilliant, baffling or wrong.
Arcades took these. Language models process text in pieces with the same name.
Ask Miss ___ in the LIBRAiRY when an AI question needs an explanation.
What a connected web tool does to find pages, and what you do for the remote.
The report, study or original announcement you trace a claim back to.
What you were asked to do to a VHS tape before returning it. Kindness had machinery involved.
These learn patterns during training; a chatbot product can be built around one of them.
The learning process that adjusts an AI model using examples.

models.hint: The plural of a word also used for a small representation of something larger.
models.explanation: AI MODELS use patterns learned during training to make predictions or generate results. A chatbot product adds other parts around a model, such as its interface and connected tools. Changing the product's settings does not necessarily change the model underneath.
models.label: Find a hint in the LIBRAiRY
models.learnLabel: See what sits inside an AI product

tokens.hint: Small units; in text, one may be only part of a word.
tokens.explanation: TOKENS are the pieces a language model processes. A text token can be a word, part of a word or punctuation. A token limit is therefore not a word limit: a short paragraph can use more tokens than its word count suggests.
tokens.label: Find a hint in the LIBRAiRY

prompt.hint: A cue to begin or continue.
prompt.explanation: A PROMPT gives the AI a request or instruction. For an invitation, say who it is for, which details must stay and what tone you want. There is no need to locate a secret incantation; the missing date is usually more useful.
prompt.label: Find a hint in the LIBRAiRY
prompt.learnLabel: Give the AI a clearer brief

input.hint: The information supplied at the beginning, rather than the answer returned.
input.explanation: INPUT is information supplied to a system. It can include your instructions and, where supported, an image or other file. If you want help reading a label, a clear photo may supply details a vague description leaves out. Check that the tool can use that format.
input.label: Find a hint in the LIBRAiRY
input.learnLabel: Choose what to give the AI

output.hint: What comes out, rather than what you put in.
output.explanation: OUTPUT is the result a system produces. It names what came back, not how reliable it is. If an AI rewrites your invitation, compare the date, place and meaning with your original before sending it. Fluency is not a fact-check.
output.label: Find a hint in the LIBRAiRY

training.hint: Practice intended to build an ability.
training.explanation: During TRAINING, a model's internal numbers are adjusted using examples and feedback. That differs from supplying a document for the current answer. A chatbot using your document does not, by itself, prove the model has been retrained on it.
training.label: Find a hint in the LIBRAiRY

source.explanation: A SOURCE lets you inspect the basis for a claim. Open it and check whether it actually supports the sentence beside the link. A real document can still be cited for something it never says. The link has arrived; the evidence may not have.
source.label: Find a hint in the LIBRAiRY
source.learnLabel: Check the evidence behind an answer

search.hint: Look for something rather than recall it from memory.
search.explanation: SEARCH can bring retrieved information into an AI answer. It does not make every result reliable or prove the final answer reflects the pages accurately. For a changed opening time, check the venue's own current notice rather than stopping at the AI's summary.
search.label: Find a hint in the LIBRAiRY

rewind.hint: Run the tape back towards its beginning.
rewind.explanation: REWIND sends a tape back towards the start. At Chick Flicks, you can revisit a LAiDIES episode instead. Return to an explanation you want to hear again; remembering every detail on the first visit is not an entrance requirement.
rewind.label: Visit the video store
rewind.learnLabel: Browse the episodes at Chick Flicks

jeeves.hint: She shares a name with a famously resourceful fictional valet.
jeeves.explanation: Miss JEEVES is the LIBRAiRY's AI-question service. Ask about the part that does not make sense and include enough detail to show what you mean. You do not need to disguise a beginner's question as an advanced one.
jeeves.label: Visit the LIBRAiRY question desk
jeeves.learnLabel: Ask Miss Jeeves an AI question
